name: Hubstaff
summary: Hubstaff costs $4.99 to $10 per seat a month on annual billing with a 2-seat minimum, and Enterprise costs $25. Activity levels and screenshots come with every plan and can be turned off. Timesheet approvals and payroll start on Team.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: Screenshots can be turned off for the whole organization, and recording of apps and URLs can be turned off in organization settings.
The payroll feature on Team and above pays people through Wise, PayPal, Payoneer and Bitwage and connects to Deel, Gusto and Remote.
GPS location tracking is an add-on at $3.33 per seat a month on Team, included on Enterprise and not offered on Starter or Grow.
Hubstaff's Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR and CCPA, with hosting on AWS in the US.
Hubstaff's help center describes a free plan for the organization owner only, while the pricing page offers a 14-day trial instead.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually; $7 on monthly billing. 2-seat minimum

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Billed annually; $9 on monthly billing. 2-seat minimum

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually; $12 on monthly billing. 2-seat minimum. Adds timesheet approvals and payroll

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds single sign-on, SCIM and GPS

hiddenCosts: Add-ons are priced per seat a month: Insights $2.50 on Starter and Grow, the silent app $2.50, GPS $3.33 on Team, longer data retention $1.67 and more screenshots $2.50.
Billing counts at least 2 seats on Starter, Grow and Team.
Hubstaff gives no prorated refunds or credits for removed users.

contract.cancellation: The terms allow cancellation at any time from the organization page and give refunds only where support deems it necessary. The pricing page separately offers a 30-day money-back guarantee.
contract.dataExport: Reports as CSV, PDF or QuickBooks format; the public API is limited to Team and Enterprise.
